# Journal of Economics and Development

## Identity
- **Abbreviation:** JED
- **Publisher:** Emerald Publishing, English edition for the National Economics University (Vietnam)
- **ISSN:** 1859-0020 (print) / 2632-5330 (online) (portal.issn.org / Editage)
- **Homepage:** https://www.emerald.com/jed
- **Author guidelines:** UNVERIFIED

## Scope
Peer-reviewed journal on economics and development in the context of global sustainability (Emerald page); accepts theoretical and empirical papers on current development issues from many economic perspectives (NEU call for papers). Finance is not named as a focus.

## Scope Keywords
economic development, Vietnam, emerging economies, economics, business, sustainability

## Article Types Accepted
- Research paper (theoretical, empirical) — others UNVERIFIED

## Classification
- **Tier:** Q2 in Economics and Econometrics — SCImago SJR 2025 = 0.810; E&E Q2; Accounting Q2; best Q1 in Economics, Econometrics and Finance (misc.) and Business, Management and Accounting (misc.) (scimagojr.com source id 21101193873)
- **Open Access:** Full OA, diamond — no APC (Emerald page); CC BY 4.0
- **Field:** Development economics

## Special Notes
Review speed (Emerald page, Apr 2024–Mar 2025): time to first decision 30 days; acceptance to publication 25 days; at least two anonymous reviewers. Emerald warns of scammers soliciting fees in the journal's name. AI policy: Emerald.
